title: Dexcom G6 Battery Status Packet Error - 8Q Transmitter
symptom: With an 8Q transmitter, the 'Transmitter Days', 'Resistance' and 'Temperature' values are all wrong. The issue is in the handling of the battery status packet.
cause: The battery status packet handling is incorrect for the new Firefly transmitters, which have packet sizes of 10 and 12, whereas the code likely assumed a different size.
fix: The issue was resolved by modifying the code in BatteryInfoRxMessage.java. The fix is implemented in xDrip, and the temperature is shown correctly starting with version 2021.07.10.
evidence_quote: I've modified the code as follows and fixed the issue: [BatteryInfoRxMessage.txt]
